title: 90s Zine Studies
description: Nine independent 90s yellow-zine studies — each spread tests explosive typography collisions, rough scissor photo cutouts, xerox-grain halftones, and rebel editorial energy at modern print precision.
creative_direction: Each image is a 1:1 magazine spread crop for a different section (cover, interview, photo essay, manifesto, fashion, music, classifieds, review, back cover). Shared palette: dominant hot yellow plus deep black plus a single accent red. Shared treatments: angled typography collisions, rough scissor-cut photo edges, xerox-grain halftones, scribble doodles, rebel attitude.
